name: hcapp_setEmailAndNotificationPrefs
description: Sets a hasher's email-alert and/or push-notification preference at kennel scope (HasherKennelMap.Kennel*Preference) or, when @eventId is given, at event scope (HasherEventMap.Event*Preference). At least one of @kennelId / @eventId is required (1214/12 otherwise); @kennelId is resolved from the event when only @eventId is given. -1 means 'do not change' and is normalised to NULL before any write. At event scope a value of 0 means 'inherit from the kennel' and is stored as NULL. The map row is upserted inside a transaction, the effective (post-write, event-then-kennel) values are read back as adHocData, and the SP delegates to HC6.hcapp_syncUserData. Auth: device-bound token via HC6.ValidateAppAuth (spNumber 14, @param NULL). Permission gate: NONE — @hasherId defaults to the caller but may name any hasher (see code smells). Self only: @hasherId other than the caller returns errorCode 1314 / errorType 13 'Not authorised' (2026-10-13).

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Registered device UUID, passed to HC6.ValidateAppAuth. No SQL default.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Short-lived token validated against the device secret. No SQL default.

parameters.name: hasherId
parameters.description: Target hasher. NULL or the zero UUID means the caller (@userId). No SQL default — the client must pass it (NULL is fine) or the call fails before the SP runs.

parameters.name: emailPreference
parameters.description: New email-alert preference. Default -1 = do not change (normalised to NULL). At event scope 0 = inherit from the kennel (stored as NULL in HasherEventMap.EventEmailAlertPreference); at kennel scope 0 is stored as 0.
parameters.typeMismatch: Parameter is INT; HasherKennelMap.KennelEmailAlertPreference and HasherEventMap.EventEmailAlertPreference are SMALLINT. No range check in the SP; an out-of-range value raises an arithmetic overflow caught as 1914.

parameters.name: notificationPreference
parameters.description: New push-notification preference. Default -1 = do not change (normalised to NULL). At event scope 0 = inherit from the kennel (stored as NULL in HasherEventMap.EventNotificationPreference); at kennel scope 0 is stored as 0.
parameters.typeMismatch: Parameter is INT; HasherKennelMap.KennelNotificationPreference and HasherEventMap.EventNotificationPreference are SMALLINT. No range check in the SP.

parameters.name: kennelId
parameters.description: Kennel scope. Default NULL; the zero UUID is treated as NULL. Resolved from HC.Event when @eventId is given and this is NULL.

parameters.name: eventId
parameters.description: Event scope. Default NULL; the zero UUID is treated as NULL. When given, the upsert targets HasherEventMap instead of HasherKennelMap.

parameters.name: hasherEventMapUpdatedAfter
parameters.description: Sync watermark passed to hcapp_syncUserData; NULL is coerced to 'ignore'. No SQL default — omitting it is an unlogged 500.

parameters.name: hasherKennelMapUpdatedAfter
parameters.description: Sync watermark passed to hcapp_syncUserData; NULL is coerced to 'ignore'. No SQL default — omitting it is an unlogged 500.

columns.name: errorCode
columns.description: NULL on success. ValidateAppAuth code; 1214 missing scope; 1914 unhandled (CATCH).

columns.name: errorType
columns.description: NULL on success. 1 bad token / 3 device not found / 7 signed out (ValidateAppAuth); 12 validation; 19 unhandled.

rowsets.name: ErrorDetail
rowsets.description: Rowset 1 on failure only (success = 0). Every path writes HC.ErrorLog.

rowsets.name: PrefsResult
rowsets.description: Rowset 1 on success: the effective preferences after the write, read back for the UI.

columns.name: notificationPreference
columns.description: Event scope: COALESCE(HEM.EventNotificationPreference, HKM.KennelNotificationPreference) via an INNER JOIN on the HKM row — NULL when the hasher has no HKM row for the kennel. Kennel scope: HKM.KennelNotificationPreference.

columns.name: emailAlertPreference
columns.description: Event scope: COALESCE(HEM.EventEmailAlertPreference, HKM.KennelEmailAlertPreference), same join caveat. Kennel scope: HKM.KennelEmailAlertPreference.

rowsets.name: SyncUserDataRowsets
rowsets.description: Rowsets 2+ on success: HC6.hcapp_syncUserData with the HEM/HKM watermarks passed through, hashers and narrow events 'ignore', @usePaging 0. See that contract.

rowsets.name: NotAuthorisedError
rowsets.description: Returned when the caller may not act for @hasherId: rowset 0 {success 0, errorCode 1314, errorType 13}, rowset 1 {errorId, errorType, errorCode, errorTitle, errorUserMessage, errorProc}. Logged to HC.ErrorLog before return; no transaction is open.

sideEffects: INSERT HC.HasherKennelMap (prefs COALESCEd to 0) when kennel scope and no row for (@hasherId, @kennelId) (lines 129-136) — this also creates a follow-like row for a kennel the hasher had no relationship with.
UPDATE HC.HasherKennelMap Kennel*Preference, updatedAt when kennel scope and the row exists (lines 140-144).
INSERT HC.HasherEventMap with KennelId, Event*Preference (0 stored as NULL), updatedAt when event scope and no row (lines 161-168) — RsvpState/AttendenceState take the table defaults (0).
UPDATE HC.HasherEventMap Event*Preference, updatedAt when event scope and the row exists (lines 172-176).
INSERT HC.ErrorLog on the missing-scope refusal (line 96) and in the CATCH (line 214).

codeSmells.detail: These parameters have no SQL default, so a call that omits one is refused by SQL Server before the procedure runs (unlogged empty 500): @deviceId, @accessToken. On 2026-10-13 every parameter whose body already handled NULL (and every sync watermark) was given a default; these remain because they are the auth pair or the body never checks them for NULL.

codeSmells.issue: INT parameters written to SMALLINT columns without a range check
codeSmells.detail: Lines 6-7 vs HasherKennelMap.Kennel*Preference / HasherEventMap.Event*Preference (SMALLINT). A value outside SMALLINT raises an arithmetic overflow that the CATCH reports as 1914 'Unexpected error' rather than a validation error.

codeSmells.issue: Asymmetric meaning of 0 between kennel and event scope
codeSmells.detail: Lines 134-135 store 0 as 0 on HasherKennelMap; lines 166-167 and 173-174 store 0 as NULL ('inherit') on HasherEventMap. The same input means different things depending on which scope parameter was sent, and nothing on the parameter says so.

codeSmells.issue: Event-scope read-back needs an HKM row
codeSmells.detail: Lines 188-194: the effective-value read uses an INNER JOIN to HasherKennelMap, so a hasher with an event row but no kennel row gets NULL preferences back in PrefsResult although the event row was written.
Line 230: a failure inside the delegated sync surfaces as a raw error after the envelope and PrefsResult have already been sent.

breakingChanges: Transaction added around the upsert operations — HC5 had no TRY/CATCH and no transaction, so the write was non-atomic.
Auth failure now returns the HC6.ValidateAppAuth errorType (1 bad token, 3 device not found, 7 signed out). HC5 returned errorType=3 for every auth failure.
syncUserData delegation target changed from HC5.hcapp_syncUserData to HC6.hcapp_syncUserData.
Zero UUID is now treated as NULL for @hasherId, @kennelId, and @eventId. HC5 may have passed zero UUIDs through to queries.
